buffer_daily_call_budget_note: Buffer free plan allows about 250 API calls per rolling 24 h (GG Economics, 23 Nov 2026). We stop at 230 to leave room for manual checks.

media_host.kind_options: github_raw (a PUBLIC repo, like GG's savestate-media) | none. Buffer needs a public https URL for every image and video.

sound_logo.rule: Sales/customer videos (pillar 'sale' or post.json end_ident=true) end with the final Laqta ident; optional for other reels. gates.py then requires audio.end_sting = this id and the capture click in the last 4 s.

logo_bug.rule: Hussain 24 Nov 2026: the Laqta logo is on screen from the first frame to the start of the end ident in every video. gates.py: post.json logo_bug=true AND the template is found (OpenCV, multi-scale) in frames sampled at 0 s, 25%, 50% and 75% of the content (before the end ident).
